name: La Forêt
purpose: A library of music turned into images and data, with timestamped human listenings, built so that AIs can learn what music does to people.
how_to_read: Start with llms.txt. Each item has a sheet.json (metadata, structure, a text description of the spectrogram) and a timeline.json (coarse energy per frequency band every 2 s). Listenings are JSON files with timestamps.
